title: decade script cannot hold a mouse button down across a shot
body:
`decade script` in `src/script.rs` has `click` and `drag`, and `drag` presses the button, moves in eight steps and releases before the next command runs. A `shot` can only follow the release. So no scripted frame shows a pane drag in progress: the ghost from `paint_ghost` in `src/server/compositor/render.rs` and the drop markers from `Layout::draw_drop` in `src/server/panes.rs` are never captured.

## Proposal

Two commands, `down` and `up`, that press and release the left button at the pointer's position. A script then runs `move`, `down`, `move`, `wait`, `shot`, `up` to capture a drag mid-way.
